title: Modern Web Guidance: make coding agents use the modern web

facts.method: Official Google Chrome README pinned to November 2 2026 commit
facts.limits: Preview release; test compatibility, accessibility and output.

scenes.say: Your coding agent can write websites. But is it using the modern web?
scenes.heading: IS YOUR AGENT OUTDATED?

scenes.say: Modern Web Guidance adds expert curated skills and guides to a compatible coding agent, so it can search for advice that fits your task.
scenes.heading: GUIDANCE FOR YOUR AGENT

scenes.say: Building a dialog or a popover? It points your agent toward modern browser APIs, accessibility, and sensible fallbacks.
scenes.heading: FROM TASK TO PLATFORM

scenes.say: Install it with this command. The setup is interactive, and the project is still a preview.
scenes.heading: INSTALL THE SKILL

scenes.say: Already have a design system? Tell your agent when to use your own components. Check browser compatibility and test the output yourself. Guidance is not a guarantee.
scenes.heading: HUMANS STILL REVIEW

scenes.say: Want the repo? Comment WEB and follow Hypeless for more tools, minus the hype.
scenes.heading: YOUR CALL
